_comment: Dynamic-range scene for the fixed-point study (moderated, ~60 dB): a strong close-in return (near target amplitude 0.3 at 3 m + leakage 0.1) and a WEAK distant off-boresight target (amplitude 0.00025 at 7 m / 25 deg, sitting just above the float detection threshold so quantization can push it under). Drives Pd (weak target) and SFDR (strong-return spurs) on this scene; Pfa is measured separately on a noise-only companion (no targets) for a clean false-alarm rate. Both targets move (nonzero Doppler so clutter removal does not suppress them); the sweep gates each target's cell per frame. Within the ~9.5 m range window. n_tx=3, n_rx=4.
